cmd:
cd /opt/trading-bot/classic
TOK=$(grep GITHUB_TOKEN /etc/vps-github-bridge/token | cut -d= -f2)
curl -sf -H "Authorization: token $TOK" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" "https://api.github.com/repos/ruslan591/weather-_Odessa/contents/bot/classic/robot_backtest.py" -o /tmp/robot_backtest.py || { echo FETCH_FAIL; exit 1; }
PYX=$(systemctl cat classicbot | grep -o 'ExecStart=[^ ]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
echo python=$PYX
case "$PYX" in *python*) ;; *) PYX=python3;; esac
rm -f /tmp/robot_bt.json /tmp/robot_bt.log
PYTHONPATH=/opt/trading-bot/classic nohup nice -n 19 timeout 2700 $PYX /tmp/robot_backtest.py 60 > /tmp/robot_bt.log 2>&1 &
sleep 25
cat /tmp/robot_bt.log | tail -5
